text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh, an iron-ball specialty shop?
Is there one around here?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you interested?
I wouldn't mind showing you around.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Yes, please!
Show me the number one iron ball in the shop!

On the way back from our outing.
Gentildonna bumped into two of her juniors and chatted with them at a cafe, but—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...! Gentil-senpai, hold on a second.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That person in that seat over there is acting kinda weird...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I thought your face looked familiar.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "Merely paparazzi. Were they perhaps plotting the downfall of our family?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"There are people like that every now and then.
Surely there are other things they ought to pursue."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll go give 'em a piece of my mind!
I'll tell 'em to stop stalking you!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
My, how kind of you.
However, it is the thought that counts, so please don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: They're just a third-rate reporter, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Still, aren't you worried?
There's no telling what people like that might do...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Chuckle... Anxious? No, not in the slightest.

While we were talking, the man walked away.
She didn't seem to pay him any mind, but...
choice_data_list: Sorry, I just need to use the restroom.

text_block_list.name: Paparazzo
text_block_list.text:
"Tch! Sharp bunch.
I gotta play it smarter next time..."
choice_data_list: Um. Do you have a moment to talk?

text_block_list.name: Paparazzo
text_block_list.text:
! You're... Heh. As expected of a Tracen Academy Trainer.
You sure care a lot about your Umamusume~.

text_block_list.name: Paparazzo
text_block_list.text:
Still, this is how I earn my bread and butter.
Persuasion won't work on me, so run along home quietly.
choice_data_list: But stalking her any more than this is...

text_block_list.name: Paparazzo
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you hear me?
I told you to quietly go home.

The huge man edges closer and closer.
The raw "pressure" radiating from his stern presence
overwhelms me before I can even react...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh, so this is where you were.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Good grief.
What are you doing, leaving a lady by herself?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you there in the sunglasses.
It seems you've been snooping around me, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Paparazzo
text_block_list.text: What the hell does that matter?! Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I do not mind in the slightest.
No matter how many swarm around, they are merely gnats after all.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
However, do be careful.
If you get too close, I might accidentally—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I　w i l l　s t r i k e　y o u　d o w n ,　y o u　k n o w ?
At that moment, the atmosphere shifted. Everything trembled under the sheer pressure she radiated—
(Bzzzzzzt... CRASH!!)

text_block_list.name: Paparazzo
text_block_list.text: E... Eeeeeek!?!?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: My, what a magnificent runaway lead.
choice_data_list: I want to become someone unflappable, too...!
I want to become someone who remains unfazed, too...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: My, what a magnificent runaway lead.
choice_data_list: I want to become someone unflappable, too...!
I want to become someone who remains unfazed, too...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Would you mind not stating the obvious?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Then try and catch up to me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: You are my Trainer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Gentil-senpai is so freakin' cool...!!
We can't afford to lose either!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes...!
Let's stay strong and keep our spirits high!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, ho ho ho.
How admirable of you.
